modes.scan: read targets.txt -> detect -> preflight -> (optional) exploit -> report

detect.oom_inconclusive_high_limit: memory_limit too high to reach OOM (inconclusive)

preflight.willing_continue: detection is information, not a gate

exploit.not_ready_abort: target NOT ready. use --force to override (still confirms).
exploit.blind_note: command executed, but no evidence channel on a live target
exploit.memory_limit_read: memory_limit {mb} MiB read from target; 'big' field set to {send} MB
exploit.memory_limit_too_high: memory_limit above 512 MB - this chain will not run here
exploit.post_max_too_small: body {mb} MB rejected by target before the script ran - post_max_size too small for stage-1
exploit.rotating_worker: rotating worker for a fresh heap

fence.title: command fence (cannot be disabled)
fence.not_whitelisted: command '{cmd}' is not in the whitelist
fence.revshell_blocked: reverse-shell primitives are blocked at runner level

shell_gen.bcrypt_note: password stored as bcrypt; plaintext NOT saved in the shell
shell_gen.upload_notice: generator only - this tool does NOT upload the shell

advisory.title: CVE advisories
advisory.patched_rebuilt: patches were rebuilt 22 Oct 2026 - check the package BUILD DATE, not just the version string
advisory.cve_115560: CVE-2026-115560 (session serialize_handler mismatch) is NOT closed by the fix-floor above
advisory.memory_limit_note: memory_limit=-1 is NOT a complete mitigation (GHSA-w8hw-w9fx-j79w)
advisory.in_wild: in-the-wild exploitation predates the patch (first attempts 17 Oct 2026)

errors.url_scheme: URL must start with http:// or https:// (got: {url})

guards_text.title: guards are enforced in CODE, not in text - they cannot be turned off
guards_text.g1: exploit only runs when READY (no hard blockers) AND --yes/confirmation
guards_text.g2: default command `id` (proof-of-access), max 14 bytes, no chaining
guards_text.g3: --revshell is NOT in the parser and is blocked at the runner level
guards_text.g4: all requests use the same stealth transport (consistent JA3)
guards_text.g5: identity-only command whitelist; bash/nc/curl permanently blocked
